title: Andhra movement and Andhra State 1953
quote: First we are Indians, then we are Andhras - B.N. Sarma, Bapatla 1913

boxes.title: Causes of the movement
items: Telugus about **40%** of Madras Presidency; **Tamil dominance** in jobs: District Judges **0** vs 19
Education (**1915**): **8 of 31** colleges; no engineering, medical or law college
Partition of Bengal **1905**; **Bihar and Orissa** separated **1912** → precedent
Papers: **Andhra Patrika** (==**Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao**==, 1908), **Krishna Patrika** (**Konda Venkatappayya**, 1902), **Deshabhimani** (Guntur)
